title: Basic Automotive Collision Repair and Refinishing
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

program.section_heading: Basic Automotive Collision Repair and Refinishing Associate of Science Degree
outcomes: Recognize damage sustained by each of the three sections of the vehicle.
Use common resources to identify the damage sustained by the vehicle.
Identify and analyze types of damage to a vehicle.

notes: The supplied text is the A.S. degree page, not a separate Certificate of Achievement section. The degree description says students must complete all requirements for the certificate plus general breadth requirements, so the 24-unit Required Courses list (Total Units 24) is read as the certificate's requirements. A reviewer should confirm against the certificate's own page.
The catalog prints codes with a leading zero (ACR 020, 022, 024, 026). These are read as the closed list's ACR 20, 22, 24 and 26, so none are marked as catalog additions.
The 60-unit minimum total and the GE patterns (SBVC GE, Cal-GETC) belong to the A.S. degree. They are not recorded for this certificate.
Footnote 1: ACR 020 may be waived through the Articulation 2+2 program with prior agreement with the instructor.
The Program Learning Outcomes are printed once on the degree page. They are recorded here on the assumption that the certificate shares them.
Careers are taken from the degree description. Workplaces named there (automotive dealerships, auto collision repair facilities, frame repair) were not recorded as careers.
